approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (2023 Law Improvement Package No. 1) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would make minor and technical changes to simplify and improve the navigability of corporations law.

It would implement recommendations from the Australian Law Reform Commission's review, including unfreezing the application of the Acts Interpretation Act to the Corporations Act and ASIC Act, and creating a single glossary for defined terms.
The bill would commence 30 days after receiving Royal Assent, but only after the Treasury Laws Amendment (Modernising Business Communications and Other Measures) Act 2023 has already commenced.
Unfreeze the application of the Acts Interpretation Act to the Corporations Act and ASIC Act.
Create a single glossary for all defined terms in the Corporations Act.
Entities subject to the Corporations Act and ASIC Act, including businesses and regulators.
Treasury Laws Amendment (2023 Law Improvement Package No. 1) Act 2023
